meta.name: timeline-report
meta.description: Generate a "Journey Into [Project]" narrative report analyzing a project's entire development history from claude-mem's timeline. Use when asked for a timeline report, project history analysis, development journey, or full project report.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目从起步到现在的开发历程整理成一篇叙事报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想回顾项目从零到现在的完整开发历程并写成一份报告
copy.tagline_en: Turn a project's development history into a narrative report
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to retell a project's full development journey as a report

howto.what: 它会从 claude-mem 的记忆时间线抓取某个项目的全部开发记录,让子代理写成一份《Journey Into 项目名》叙事报告,覆盖项目起源、架构演变、关键突破、技术债、Token 经济等章节,并保存为 markdown 文件。
howto.when: 当你要求「写时间线报告」「分析项目历史」或「完整项目报告」等时触发;前提是 claude-mem worker 正在运行,且该项目已有 claude-mem 观测记录。

say.text: 为 tokyo 项目写一份 Journey 报告
say.note: 会抓取该项目的完整时间线,再生成报告

say.text: 分析我这个项目的完整开发历史
say.note: 以当前目录所属项目作为数据源
改用你指定的路径保存报告

howto.what_en: Once installed, it pulls a project's full claude-mem timeline and has a subagent write a “Journey Into [Project]” narrative report covering genesis, architecture, breakthroughs, technical debt and token economics, saved as a markdown file.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a timeline report, project history analysis, or full project report. Requires the claude-mem worker running and recorded observations for that project.

say_en.text: Write a Journey report for the tokyo project
say_en.note: Fetches that project's full timeline, then writes the report

say_en.text: Analyze the full development history of this project
say_en.note: Uses the current directory's project as the data source
Saves to your path instead of the default
